connections.why: Jevons's evidence for the paradox was the steam engine: he counted Watt's condenser among the economies of coal that, in his argument, made Britain burn more of it, and that frame tells how Watt's engine came to use about half the coal of Newcomen's.
DeepSeek's V3, the openly released model whose reported training cost set off the Jevons argument of January 2025, is one of the open-weights models that frame follows.
Efficiency per computation rose for decades while total use first held flat and then rose, the evidence both readings of rebound draw on.
Whether cheaper AI computing raises total demand is half of whether the building will be repaid.
DeepSeek's January 2025 claim of cheap training cut both ways for the race argument: less compute needed, or more use.
